positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained the company’s internal developer platform in Go that supports 500+ services
• Provisioned and maintained AWS resources using CloudFormation, Terrafrom and AWS CDK
• Increased log availability 200x by migrating 150TB/month logs from Datadog to a ClickHouse-based observability platform
• Developed a LogQL-compatible query layer for ClickHouse-based observability platform
• Led initiatives to improve engineering culture by standardizing code review guidelines

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Contributed to an established SaaS application in Node.js, and TypeScript
• Interacted with third-party APIs to synchronize patient, payers, and appointment information
• Troubleshooted and optimized PostgreSQL queries
• Maintained Docker images to ensure a consistent developer environment
• Utilized Datadog and Sentry to identify pain-points in our application
• Migrated sections of Rivet’s build system from Make to Bazel to increase build and testing performance

positions.title: Software Developer and Researcher
positions.description:
* Developed a REST API using FastAPI to store data from learning management systems
* Developed a Full Stack web application using Flask, ReactJS, PostgreSQL and Docker to easily visualize GitHub data
* Explored ways to visualize GitHub repository collaboration within a class environment

positions.title: Information Technology Support Staff
positions.description:
* Work with managers to setup computers that will be used on campus
* Troubleshoot computer problems brought by students, faculty and staff
* Maintain upkeep of printers across campus

positions.title: Artificial Intelligence Research Assistant
positions.description:
During the summer of 2019, I assisted my Computer Science professor in a research project.
* Worked in Java and Python to use GANs to procedurally generate video game dungeons based off of The Legend of Zelda
* Create a game to test the generated dungeons
* Present my project in poster and presentation form on campus
* Maximize my experience by applying to research conferences and writing a paper
* Hold a human subject study to determine which video game dungeon generation technique is enjoyable

positions.title: Community Engaged Learning Student Assistant
positions.description:
* Work with a local non-profit
* Work with non-profit about any computer issues they may have

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
* Teach kids game design and programming through Scratch and Roblox Studio. Teach basic programming concepts (variables, functions, comments, operators, loops, if-else)
* Teach kids problem solving skills through Minecraft
* Troubleshoot Windows 10 computers and a Linux server
* Operate Minecraft servers

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with Minor in Business

projects.title: Gitlytics
projects.description:
A full-stack web application written using Flask and React with Material-UI and Rechart.

Gitlytics allows faculty to track and visualize Github collaboration for their classes.

publications.title: Generative Adversarial Network Rooms in Generative Graph Grammar Dungeons for The Legend of Zelda
Interactive evolution and exploration within latent level-design space of generative adversarial networks
publications.publisher: GECCO '20: Proceedings of the 2020 Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference · Jun 25, 2020
